climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A very cold state where many vines are buried under soil for winter. It does extensive research on cold-hardy hybrids, and Frontenac, Marquette and La Crescent are the most planted. It hosts the International Cold Climate Wine Competition.
